name: Packie the Turf Cutter

intro.text: I've a bank of turf to save before the rain. You've got about four minutes. Then I need my sleán back.

win: Ah, you've a fine strong arm on you. Ever think of cutting turf? No? Nobody does any more.
after: Cut, spread, foot, clamp, carry home. And then it rains on you anyway. That's turf.
